title: Docs for v0.27.0: user guide coverage of everything merged since v0.26.0

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P5
labels.description: Agent surface and tooling keep up with what shipped

body:
Running list of user-facing changes merged to `main` since **v0.26.0** that the user guide (`site/`) must cover before the 0.27.0 cut. Generated from each merged PR's `Changelog:` line (51 so far); doc PRs land on `main` in batches during the day and tick items here. Owner of the cut decides what can ship undocumented.

**Features (feat)**
- [x] #2831 Face, 2D Contour and Slot have arc turns with a corner arc radius (`blend_turns`, `blend_radius`); a default operation does not change.
- [x] #2964 The native wire EDM job files post accepts measured QN2 stock thicknesses of 15, 20, 40 and 80 mm. Corner checks use the measured rough offset of the selected thickness.
- [x] #2968 The native wire EDM job files accept a vertical punch with checked reentrant corners and refuse features that the rough wire cannot reach safely.
- [x] #2969 The native wire EDM job files post accepts a selected convex through-opening in a 20 mm plate. It writes the zero-step setup with the die side and checks the retained plate, the inward lead and the rough offset before 
- [x] #2972 The native wire EDM job files post accepts one straight open cutoff in 20 mm stock. It writes the zero-step setup with the left or right side, separate entry and exit points in air and no separation. It requires confir
- [x] #2974 The native wire EDM job files post groups two independently captured punches on one 20 mm plate in one job, after it checks that their complete cutting areas stay apart.
- [x] #2978 A selected DXF circle or racetrack chain can drive a Wire Contour punch, and the native wire EDM job writes its nominal arcs as G03 blocks.
- [x] #2979 The native wire EDM job can request work quality CCB035 (Ra 0.35 µm, speed option) for one closed polygon punch on 20 mm steel with Berco Cut 0.25 mm wire. The control then preselects the 5-pass Ra 0.35 technology. The
- [x] #3059 A 2D Chamfer can now machine one or more selected open edge chains without cutting the complete edge loop.
- [x] #3061 Import SVG drawings (paths, shapes, group transforms, mm/cm/in/pt/pc/px sizes) as 2D profiles on the stock, with the `import_svg` MCP tool and `cam.importSvg`; an SVG with no physical size is refused until you state it
- [x] #3219 Export a selected closed DXF opening as a native, zero-step Classic Cut 2S inspection setup from desktop, CLI or MCP.
- [x] #3458 Engrave and Trace can cut open and closed sketch chains without a 3D part. Both operations preserve arcs and verify the mark against stock.
- [x] #3547 Desktop builds check GitHub Releases at most once a day and show an Update available notice in the title bar, with a Settings toggle.
- [x] #3550 Added a Waterlines switch to 3D Finish operations to skip steep-flank ring passes with a visible uncut-flank warning and all-steep refusal.
- [x] #3611 `camcraft-ui --read-only` and `open_project` with `read_only: true` open a project read-only: Save never writes over the opened file, and Save As writes your own copy.
- [x] #3630 multiaxis: Rotary Flow - a 4-axis flow-line finishing kernel between picked helical guide chains on a stated rotation axis
- [ ] #3833 An outside 2D Contour with entry ramp or helix ramps onto each level along the lead-in and the ring.
- [ ] #3861 `camcraft-cli --ui [--window <pid|project>] call <tool> [<json>]` (and `--ui mcp`, `--ui windows`) sends MCP tool calls to a running CamCraft window, which runs them on its own undo history; with no window it exits 3 a
- [ ] #3900 The Tools ribbon cell opens the tool library in its own window, which can stay open beside the viewport. The "Tool library" dock tab is gone.
- [ ] #3903 Edit a tool's geometry and catalog facts in the tool library window. Apply is one undo step.

**Fixes that change what a user sees or does (fix)**
- [ ] #3496 Rotary Offset Zigzag levels finish their walls with a closing
- [ ] #3516 Support Do not touch protected faces and edges on 2D Pocket operations
- [ ] #3579 A 2D Pocket corner relief that no pass reaches is now named in the operation notes instead of being dropped silently.
- [ ] #3762 Shared GPU errors disable compute and retain the CPU fallback instead of causing an uncaptured-error panic.
- [ ] #3765 The Lead in / Lead out page has an Approach distance (default 2 mm) for passes that start Inside or Outside: how far outside the stock edge the tool goes down to the cut depth. It is saved in the project, undoable, and
- [ ] #3766 Correct the V-Carve Stepdown default in the guide.
- [ ] #3770 verify now lists the plasma laws' tip-up and kerf-crossing warnings as findings (`plasma_tip_up`, `plasma_kerf_crossing`, not blocking) and in the operation's warnings, not only in the gate's not-judged line.
- [ ] #3775 The fanuc, doosan-dnm, mazak, sinumerik, tormach and linuxcnc posts write the exact G84 tap feed (for example F34.5, not F35) and refuse a tap whose written F and S change the pitch.
- [ ] #3777 Rapid contact with the part names the part and move instead of describing stock below the clearance plane.
- [ ] #3780 Check Waterline ring links against the model and use clearance for a blocked rapid.
- [ ] #3787 Preserve decimal points in Fanuc, Doosan DNM and Mazak feed words to prevent integer feed scaling.
- [ ] #3790 2D Offset "Pass starts at" round a part: Auto, Inside and Outside now cut the same contour-parallel rings (offsets of the part), with fill rings where two sides of the part merge. The choice changes only the start side
- [ ] #3797 Keep machine assignment visible while scrolling and support undoable double-click assignment.
- [ ] #3798 Add API key setup, provider readiness, and setup help to AI Chat.
- [ ] #3799 AI Chat selects an installed Ollama model that can call tools and uses current cloud model defaults.
- [ ] #3801 The Fanuc and Doosan DNM posts return the rotary axes to zero (after G49 and the Z retract) at the end of a program whose last section is tilted.
- [ ] #3805 Explain narrow stock-band refusals with the band width, tool size, stock to leave, and corrective advice.
- [ ] #3808 The Envelope verifier detects gouges from straight, upright bull-nose cuts and reports remaining stock as unmeasured.
- [ ] #3818 2D Offset "Pass starts at" Inside, Outside and Auto: the rings stay at depth and link in the cut plane (through air or cut material, and along the edge of the area); the tool lifts only where each in-plane link would c
- [ ] #3823 2D Offset "Pass starts at" Inside and Outside: the Arc entry plunges in air outside the stock box (tool radius plus the approach distance) and arcs onto the first ring in the cut plane with the Arc radius and Arc sweep
- [ ] #3837 2D Pocket and 2D Offset round a part: a ring link that fails now lifts to the clearance height when the pass link is Clearance, and the note names that plane; Zigzag rows keep their earlier links.
- [ ] #3855 2D Offset "Pass starts at" Inside and Outside read the part wall as one wall where the stock edge is near it: on fig8 the tool no longer lifts across the part to two tiny wall stretches and plunges into material there,
- [ ] #3857 3D Pocket: a pass that starts again inside a level now enters by the operation's helix or ramp (or a ramp along the pass) instead of a straight plunge into uncut stock.
- [ ] #3858 2D Offset: a change of "Pass starts at" from Auto to Inside or Outside now sets the Arc lead-in when the lead-in is still the default Helix.
- [ ] #3860 camcraft-cli mcp runs a generate on a worker thread: get_job and save_project answer while it runs, and notifications/cancelled drops it.
- [ ] #3862 A 2D Pocket now warns at edit time (MCP `warning`) when its tool has no position in the region that Generate cuts; a Slot width or stock-to-leave edit that leaves the tool too wide is refused.
- [ ] #3872 2D Offset "Pass starts at" Inside or Outside: a selected Helix, Ramp or Plunge lead-in is kept and gives one warning that recommends Arc (also shown on the Lead in / Lead out page); the automatic dead-end ramp is remov
- [ ] #3875 A Face with "Do not touch" items is now refused, with the depth that it can reach, when an item blocks the lower facing levels. Before, the face stopped above Cut Z and only a note said so.
- [ ] #3887 Report busy window and exit 4 when a second --ui call occurs during an active command.
- [ ] #3890 A 2D Contour under control or wear compensation now refuses a Ramp or Helix entry (or level transition) by name; the ramp ran on the ring before G41/G42 engaged and could cut the wall.
- [ ] #3905 3D Pocket: a pass restart with a tool that is not centre-cutting no longer refuses the operation when the earlier cuts cleared the tool's core; it takes a helix or ramp where one fits, else the named plunge.

Done means: every item above is either covered in the guide (linked doc PR) or marked "no doc needed" with a reason, before the 0.27.0 release branch is cut. Related: #3764 (run the site tests before a cut).
